findings.passage: What we're asking for: reasonable, reasonable measures around gun laws and gun safety, and you'll see me looking into that.
findings.note: Quoted by WEWS (News 5 Cleveland), said on a Thursday before the Oct 19 2026 story. She calls for reasonable gun-safety measures; the story describes her as a big supporter of the Second Amendment (reporter's words).

findings.passage: Eighty percent of gun owners want reasonable, reasonable measures, background checks, red flag laws, safety for keeping guns at home
findings.note: Quoted by WEWS (News 5 Cleveland). She cites polling and names background checks, red flag laws and safe home storage as measures gun owners want, calling them bipartisan.
